Create Blank Class Lists for Schools Without Wonde Data

Source: R/blank_class_list.R
create_school_blanks.Rd

Creates placeholder class lists for schools without Wonde access. School information is read from `schools_with_size`; class and teacher details can be specified or generated automatically. Output uses the package's configured column names.

Usage

create_school_blanks(
  schools_with_size,
  numbering_type = "school",
  teacher_name = c("Reception", "Teacher"),
  class_name = "Reception Class",
  type = 30,
  class_buffer = 5,
  class_size = 30,
  class_list_columns = "master"
)

Arguments

schools_with_size

Data frame with a school name (configured `est_wonde_name` or `SchoolName`), a school URN (configured `urn`), and `NoStudents`. Optional columns are `ClassInfo`, `TeacherInfo`, and the configured `est_id` (establishment number).

numbering_type

Either `"school"` (placeholder pupil numbers continue across classes within a school) or `"class"` (restart at 1 per class).

teacher_name

Character vector of length 2 containing default teacher first name and surname. Defaults to `c("Reception", "Teacher")`.

class_name

Base class name used when generating classes automatically.

type

If a single non-negative whole number, the number of blank rows per automatically generated class. Otherwise, e.g. `"auto"`, use `ceiling(NoStudents / number_of_classes) + class_buffer`.

class_buffer

Non-negative whole number added to automatically estimated class sizes when `type` is not numeric.

class_size

Positive whole number used to calculate how many classes a school needs when `ClassInfo` is not supplied.

class_list_columns

`"master"`, `"print"`, or a character vector of internal column keys and/or configured column names. Additional literal names are allowed and filled with `NA` if unavailable. The `master` preset includes `DATE_OF_WITHDRAWAL`, an extra field not in the column mapping.

Value

Data frame in the requested column order and configured naming convention. With no schools or zero-sized schools, returns a zero-row data frame with the requested columns.

Details

`ClassInfo` accepts entries like `"A -> 28, B -> 30"`. Those class sizes are used as provided, independently of `NoStudents` and `type`. `TeacherInfo` accepts comma-separated full names, e.g. `"Jane Smith, Alex Jones"`; one teacher can be reused across all classes, or one teacher may be supplied per class. The separator `—` is also supported between teachers. Names are split at the first space.

Placeholder pupil numbers are stored in the configured `sfn` column; other pupil-specific information is missing (`NA`). The function does not assign real OME IDs, print IDs or student Wonde IDs.

See also

Other class_list: add_student_to_school_class(), clean_teacher_names(), produce_class_lists(), reduce_to_best_teacher(), remove_class(), remove_school_from_class_list(), remove_student_from_class(), update_class_name(), update_class_teacher(), update_school_name(), update_student_class()

Examples

schools <- data.frame(
  SchoolName = "Oak Primary", URN = "123456", NoStudents = 45
)
blanks <- create_school_blanks(schools, class_list_columns = "master")
